title: API Surface Delta Sentinel: competitor endpoint contract change catalog & breakage-risk scoring
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: competitors (hosted LLM APIs and inference providers) regularly change their endpoint payloads, param names, streaming semantics, and error codes. These deltas cause integration friction for Redwood customers and create hidden switching costs. We need a repeatable, automated way to capture API contract changes across providers, classify their potential impact on Redwood products, and surface prioritized alerts to PM/Eng/Sales.
goals: Build a small, low-cost fleet of lightweight probes that exercise competitor endpoints and record API surface (schema, params, HTTP codes, streaming frames, rate-limit behaviors).

Produce a daily delta report with semantic classification (breaking vs additive vs noop) and an estimated breakage-risk score tied to our product surfaces (SDK, Console integrations, onboarding templates).
Integrate delta alerts into the Redwood Console watchtower so PMs and SREs can triage potential customer-impacting changes within 24 hours.
Deliver an initial MVP supporting 6 target providers and a simple UI + Slack webhook for alerts.
success_metrics: MVP supports 6 providers and runs daily with <8% false positive detection rate
Mean time to detect a breaking contract change <= 24 hours
PM/SRE triage time <= 48 hours for high-risk alerts
Two production bugs avoided in first quarter of operation (post-rollout improvement metric).
out_of_scope: Full automated remediation or API rewrites
Deep behavioral/model-output diffs beyond basic contract/semantic changes (this ticket focuses on the API surface/contract).
tasks: Define the canonical contract snapshot format (headers, endpoints, param schema, response envelope, streaming markers, error codes)
Prototype probe harness that can replay a set of canonical requests and capture differences (HTTP logs + JSON schema extraction)
Implement a comparator that classifies deltas: additive, semantic rename, param-type-change, response-envelope-change, error-code-change, streaming-protocol-change
Design breakage-risk heuristic that maps delta classes to product surfaces (SDK, console integrations, on-prem templates) and outputs a score 0-100
Build storage and daily job runner (S3 or internal storage + scheduled runner) to persist snapshots and diffs
Expose a minimal alerting pipeline: (1) daily digest email/console report, (2) high-risk Slack webhook to #pm-watchtower
Create triage playbook for PM+SRE with suggested first actions and mappings to existing remediation templates
Ship MVP UI with list view, diff view, and risk score for each detected delta
acceptance_criteria: Automated probes run nightly against 6 providers and produce snapshots for each exercised endpoint
Comparator produces categorized deltas and a numeric breakage-risk score for each delta
High-risk deltas trigger Slack webhook and create a Console alert card (mocked or simple integration)
Engineering review confirms snapshot+diff format is sufficient for triage without additional logs
Playbook and runbook published in our Confluence and linked from the alert card
notes: Trade-offs considered: dynamic probing increases fidelity but risks rate-limit blocks (prototype will use low-frequency sampling + provider-friendly headers). We will not attempt to reverse-engineer private endpoints. For streaming, we will record frame boundaries and common event markers, not full continuous transcripts.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Provider rate-limiting / IP blocking — Mitigation: rotate low-volume IPs, respect robots policies, include attribution headers
Risk: False positives due to transient outages — Mitigation: require delta to persist for 2 runs (48 hours) before high-risk escalation
Risk: Legal / TOS issues — Mitigation: consult Legal on allowed probe patterns; avoid credentialed/proprietary calls
deliverables: Prototype probe harness repo and README (internal)
Daily delta pipeline and storage of snapshots
MVP alerting integration into Slack and Console
roadmap_notes: Phase 1 (MVP): 6 providers, nightly runs, Slack alerts. Phase 2: expand to 20 providers, integrate semantic model-output deltas, surface cost/latency delta signals, and hook to sales/solutions engineering alerts.
